series: What if the countries were swapped?
title: What if Mo Salah was Spanish?
checked: Salah's Egypt debut 2011. AFCON 2017 final: Egypt led, Cameroon won 2-1 with Aboubakar's 88th-minute goal, Libreville, 5 Feb 2017 (Wikipedia, Goal). AFCON 2021 final (6 Feb 2022): 0-0, Senegal won 4-2 on pens, Mané the winning kick (Wikipedia, FotMob). 29 March 2022 World Cup play-off v Senegal: Salah, lit by green lasers, shot his penalty over; Mané scored the winner again (SI, Yahoo, FotMob). 2026: Egypt's first World Cup knockout game, led Argentina 2-0, lost 3-2 with a stoppage-time winner, 7 July, Atlanta (Al-Monitor, i24). Spain since 2011: Euro 2012, Nations League 2023, Euro 2024, World Cup 2026 (Ferran Torres, 106th minute, 1-0 aet v Argentina, 19 July) (Wikipedia, IOL, ITV). The Spain-Salah goal is clearly imagined. Kits in the game footage are plain.

lines.text: Mo Salah has played in two Africa Cup of Nations finals for Egypt. He lost both. What if he'd been born in Spain?
lines.say: Mo Sahlah has played in two Africa Cup of Nations finals for Egypt. He lost both. What if he'd been born in Spain?

lines.text: 2017. Egypt lead Cameroon in the final. Then the winner goes in with two minutes left.
lines.say: Twenty seventeen. Egypt lead Cameroon in the final. Then the winner goes in with two minutes left.

lines.text: 2022. The final against Senegal goes to penalties. His Liverpool team-mate Sadio Mané scores the winner.
lines.say: Twenty twenty-two. The final against Senegal goes to penalties. His Liverpool team-mate Sadio Mahnay scores the winner.

lines.text: Seven weeks later, a World Cup place at stake. Green lasers in his face, Salah blazes his penalty over.
lines.say: Seven weeks later, a World Cup place at stake. Green lasers in his face, Sahlah blazes his penalty over.

scene.headline: Salah misses as Senegal win shoot-out
scene.standfirst: Fans shine green lasers at Egypt's players in Dakar. Mané scores the decisive penalty again, and Egypt miss the World Cup.

lines.text: This summer, Egypt's first ever World Cup knockout game. They go two-nil up against Argentina.
And lose three-two, to a winner in stoppage time.
Now Spain, in the same years. Euro 2012. The Nations League. Euro 2024.
lines.say: Now Spain, in the same years. Euro twenty twelve. The Nations League. Euro twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: And this summer, the World Cup. Ferran Torres wins the final in extra time.
lines.say: And this summer, the World Cup. Feran Torres wins the final in extra time.

lines.text: That's four major trophies while Salah has been playing. Egypt have none.
lines.say: That's four major trophies while Sahlah has been playing. Egypt have none.

lines.text: So in this alternate world, Salah is Spain's right winger. Lamine Yamal would have a fight on his hands.
lines.say: So in this alternate world, Sahlah is Spain's right winger. Lameen Yamal would have a fight on his hands.

lines.text: And in this imagined final, it's Salah who scores the winner.
lines.say: And in this imagined final, it's Sahlah who scores the winner.

lines.text: Four trophies instead of none, and a World Cup winner's medal.
Egypt's king, or Spain's world champion? Which would you pick? Tell me in the comments.
